description: glTF 2.0 model rendering library for Minecraft Forge/NeoForge 1.20.1

mods.name: Polymesh
mods.description:
Polymesh renders glTF 2.0 models in Minecraft.
Mods can use it to control animations and read model data.

releases.notes:
Polymesh 1.0.0 renders glTF 2.0 models in Minecraft Forge and NeoForge 1.20.1.

## Files

| File | Use |
|---|---|
| `polymesh-1.0.0-forge.jar` | Put this file in the Minecraft `mods` folder. It includes the jgltf and Jackson dependencies. |
| `polymesh-1.0.0-dev.jar` | Use this file for mod development with Mojang mappings. |
| `polymesh-1.0.0-sources.jar` | Use this file as the source attachment in your IDE. |

## Model functions

- Load `.gltf` and `.glb` files with textures.
- Render static meshes, animated meshes, skins, and morph targets.
- Control animation speed, clip transitions, bone transforms, and morph weights.
- Select entity and block entity models by camera distance.
- Read glTF `extras` metadata from mod code.

With an active Iris or Oculus shader pack, the default setting selects a Minecraft vertex consumer.
The shader pack controls the lighting.

## Limits

The CPU calculates skin and morph deformation.
The renderer does not apply emissive textures or metallic and roughness properties.
Items use the base model at all distances.
Polymesh does not calculate physics or mesh collisions.
The `strictValidation` option has no effect in this version.

Read the [developer guide](https://github.com/phe6/polymesh/blob/v1.0.0/docs/POLYMESH_PROJECT.md) for installation and API examples.
